_: Mobile area: the phone app shell — sign in with C-Sweet, My Headquarters (enterprise chooser), connection status and account sign-out.
_dynamic: Mobile.Role.* is resolved from the role name each Headquarters publishes to the C-Sweet directory.
Mobile.Entry.Title: Sign in to C-Sweet
Mobile.Entry.Lead: Use your C-Sweet account to find the Headquarters you can use.
Mobile.Entry.Cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
Mobile.Entry.Failed: Couldn't sign in. Check your connection and try again.
Mobile.Entry.Expired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
Mobile.Chooser.Title: My Headquarters
Mobile.Chooser.Empty.Title: You haven't joined an enterprise yet
Mobile.Chooser.Empty.Body: Headquarters you set up with this account, or are added to, appear here.
Mobile.Pending.Body: This phone isn't connected to {name} yet.
Mobile.SignOut.Explain: This phone will forget your C-Sweet sign-in and your Headquarters list. Your Headquarters and its data are not affected.
Mobile.Connect.EnrollmentRequired: This phone still needs approval at {name} before it can open your businesses.
Mobile.Connect.NotConfigured: {name} hasn't turned on phone access yet.
Mobile.Connect.NoAccess: You don't have access to {name} anymore.
Mobile.Connect.Unreachable: Couldn't reach {name}. Check that it's running and try again.
Mobile.Connect.SecureFailed: The secure connection to {name} failed. If this keeps happening, stop and check with the Headquarters owner.
Mobile.Connect.Refused: The connection service refused this phone. Try again.
Mobile.Connect.HowToApprove: On a computer signed in to {name}, open Settings → Phones and approve this phone.
Mobile.Connect.Revoked: This phone's access to {name} was revoked.
Mobile.Connect.NoAccountAccess: Your C-Sweet account doesn't have access to {name}.
Mobile.Connect.Rejected: {name} didn't accept this phone's sign-in. Sign out, sign in again and retry.
